description: Temporal workflow running an OpenAI Agents agent with one activity tool, on the dev server.
notes: The pinned Temporal CLI runs the dev server headless (dev_server_existing_path avoids the SDK's runtime download). The tracer provider is temporalio's replay-safe one with a batch OTLP exporter reading the runner's OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* environment, set globally before the plugin instruments. OpenAIAgentsPlugin(use_otel_instrumentation=True) instruments OpenAI Agents itself, so no OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor runs (a second one would double the spans), and OpenTelemetryPlugin(add_temporal_spans=True) adds Temporal's own spans. The model calls go through the Responses API to the mock. All 22 spans are kept: 14 from the plugin (the OpenAI Agents agent, chain, turn, LLM and tool spans plus temporal:startActivity/executeActivity chains) and 8 from Temporal itself (StartWorkflow, RunWorkflow, StartActivity and RunActivity, which stay untyped spans). temporalRunID is a UUID per run.
